answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake and earn a single, transfer-proof reputation record before it can trade. Think of a wharf where every arriving vessel is inspected and its cargo logged in marble, not sand: one identity, one ledger entry, no cheap copies. A raven-like messenger carrying forged credentials is caught because its stake is slashed and its record is burned. An attacker must therefore fund, age, and risk a separate stake for every fake identity, so creating thousands of Sybils costs thousands of deposits and forfeits them on detection.
